actions.name: issueNumber
actions.note: internal, called inside the seal transaction; not a public route

behaviour: A wish gets its number when it is paid for, in payment order, from one database sequence; never reused, never chosen by a client (T-57).
Shown as 'Wish № 0412': at least 4 digits, zero padded; past 9999 it simply grows.
Wish № 0001 is Aisha's house showcase wish (T-57); the sequence for customers starts at 0002.
Business client wishes draw from the same sequence.
Replaces STUB-8 (random 4-digit numbers made in the browser).
